rows.text: walks the `0x20` qwords starting at `rcx+0xA0` and issues the call at `001BBF40` + 0x2B on each non-null one, then issues the call at `001BBF40` + 0x49 with (`rcx+0xA0`, 0, `0x100`) and tail-jumps at `001BBF40` + 0x71 with (`rcx+0x1A0`, 0, `0x100`)

takes the dword `+4` of the table at qword `rcx-0x90` as an offset `d` (read before each of the first two stores), stores the address `00901028` to the qword at `rcx - 0x90 + d` and `d - 0x90` to the dword at `rcx - 0x94 + d`, stores `00900F20` to qword `rcx-0x80`, issues the call at `001DE180` + 0x50 and then the indirect call at `001DE180` + 0x59, both with `rcx-0x80`, and tail-jumps through the indirect jump at `001DE180` + 0x6D with `rcx-0x78`
